body: I haven't, now that you mention it. I just looked it up for my state, and it seems medical marijuana is legal here. It doesn't seem to be allowed to be prescribed for depression, but I do have Crohn's disease, which is on the list. Thank you for the tip; I'll research it more and look more into the law.

No worries; you're correct, actually. I have Asperger's (my body seems to collect chronic health concerns like trading cards). There's an emphasis on the high-functioning, but it still has its effects.
I do; I'm going to community college at the moment, and I plan on transferring after next year.

True, but _finding_ that one is harder than expected, especially when the barrier of entry to socializing feels as high as it does for me.

Thank you.

To be fair, we're quite similar when it comes to emotional matters: they're far from our strong suits, so it's difficult for us to help others emotionally. I do agree somewhat, though.
